evidence_classes.legacy_self_check: historical production/regression self-check; not independent evidence
evidence_classes.independent_direct_function_oracle: closed-form expected value written independently of the target production helper
evidence_classes.external_vendor_published_cross_implemen: published SCAD/KRISTALL numerical comparator; not a live vendor run
evidence_classes.external_user_supplied_transcription: report supplied in chat and preserved as an explicit transcription, not an original file
evidence_classes.remediation_regression: test proving a defect exposed by validation remains corrected

anti_overclaim_rules: Scalar agreement does not establish the whole normative route.
Source-side inconsistencies remain visible and block golden promotion.
Vendor interpolation behavior is evidence of that implementation, not automatically a normative rule.
A full Change 6 rebaseline is not claimed by targeted remediation.
